src: start markers: isolated single pixels whose colors belong to a template cycle shown as 2x2 monochrome blocks in the top-left
path: enter the main path region (the most frequent non-template color) and move one cell per step; keep heading until a collision with non-path
trajectory: paint the path with a repeating color cycle (cycle order = 2x2 blocks left→right; advance cycle each step)
dst: stop when leaving the grid, or when the scheduled turn is blocked
transform: erase the template 2x2 blocks and the 2x2 end block; while moving, recolor visited path cells by the cycle; on collision into template background, paint that collided cell with the end-block color as a corner marker
turn_rule: CRUCIAL: collisions enforce strict alternating 90° turns: 1st/3rd/5th… turn left (CCW), 2nd/4th/6th… turn right (CW); if the scheduled turn cell is not path, STOP (no fallback)
notes: initial direction is the first adjacent path neighbor in priority R,D,L,U; cycle index starts at the marker’s own color within the cycle; apply independently for each marker
